title: SMX Starship signal event
description: One timestamped, sourced fact about Starship progress. Append-only: corrections are new events that name the event they supersede.

eventTime.description: When it happened, or the published NET for type=scheduled.

plans.description: type=scheduled only: objectives the source says are planned.

published.description: Publish date as shown by the source.

confidence.description: official = the operator or a regulator; reported = named press; unverified = needs a human check. The reference agent ignores unverified events.

supersedes.description: id of an earlier event this one corrects.
